text: The free, GitHub-integrated repository that automatically archives a project's releases and assigns each a persistent, citable DOI is called ___.
explanation: Zenodo offers free, unlimited archiving with native GitHub integration that automatically creates an archived snapshot (with a DOI) whenever a new release is published, making code, data, and models permanently citable. Figshare provides broadly similar DOI-based archiving but is commercially backed and is not the tool described as free/unlimited with native GitHub release integration.
